privacy_posture: Do not store names, addresses, claim numbers, case numbers, screenshots of private accounts, or private records. Store claim class, source posture, locator, limitations, and minimum next receipt only.
closure_policy: No receipt below field-validated person or household outcome proof can close a live gap; aggregate feedback, observation, counsel, filing, or report surfaces must remain blockers unless they join to completed person/household outcomes.

proof_floor_labels.aggregate_claimant_feedback_or_observati: claimant survey or observation signal about burden/friction, but not completed money, debt, waiver, appeal, or remedy outcome
proof_floor_labels.aggregate_household_outcome_surface: aggregate household representation or outcome surface, but not privacy-approved household-tail validation across non-users, informal exits, and durable stability
proof_floor_labels.dataset_or_docket_boundary: dataset, filing, docket, or register proves a surface boundary but not the human outcome
proof_floor_labels.field_validated_person_outcome: privacy-approved direct or independently collected affected-person outcome proof
proof_floor_labels.official_policy_or_guidance: policy/guidance source supports a proof requirement but not a person outcome
proof_floor_labels.partial_oversight_or_outcome_surface: oversight/result surface suggests implementation state but lacks household/claimant tail
proof_floor_labels.program_playbook_or_report: implementation guidance, report, survey, or user-test surface supports a test but not complete validation

receipts.affected_person_gap: No direct claimant, applicant, or non-user outcome evidence has been collected in this cube row.
receipts.claim: Public-benefit access proof must include beginning-to-end burden and direct feedback, not only form or portal completion.
receipts.closure_rule: Blocks repair claims until field/person outcome evidence is added; may justify tests and source boundaries only.
receipts.denominator_gap: Applicants, non-users, abandonments, assisted-channel users, and subgroup burdens are not directly measured by this receipt.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs a privacy-approved public-benefit journey sample that includes applicants, abandonments, non-users, assisted-channel users, and outcome/remedy result.
minimum_next_receipts: burden measure by channel and subgroup
receipts.risk_if_missing: The archive may treat a survey clearance or burden framework as proof that people actually accessed a benefit.
receipts.source_locator: OMB A-11 Section 280.6 post-transaction customer feedback; OMB M-22-10 executive summary on beginning-to-end experience, burden, and consultation.

receipts.affected_person_gap: No household follow-up connects filing, judgment, lockout, informal move-out, shelter, or re-housing outcome.
receipts.claim: Eviction filing data are exposure evidence, not physical eviction, informal eviction, shelter, or re-housing proof.
receipts.closure_rule: Blocks repair claims until field/person outcome evidence is added; may justify tests and source boundaries only.
receipts.denominator_gap: Informal move-outs, illegal lockouts, households never reaching counsel, screening-excluded applicants, and durable housing tails remain unjoined.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs household follow-up that includes informal move-outs, lockouts, court and non-court exits, shelter/re-housing, and stability after the filing or threat.
minimum_next_receipts: informal move-out or illegal lockout indicator
receipts.risk_if_missing: The archive may count the start of court as the household outcome.
receipts.source_locator: GAO eviction-data-limit report; Eviction Lab tracking system filing surface.

receipts.affected_person_gap: No household-level receipt yet proves outreach, intake, counsel at hearing, settlement quality, possession, and durable housing tail.
receipts.claim: Right-to-counsel evidence must distinguish legal entitlement, representation rate, counsel at the operative event, and stable housing result.
receipts.closure_rule: Blocks repair claims until field/person outcome evidence is added; may justify tests and source boundaries only.
receipts.denominator_gap: Informal move-outs, illegal lockouts, households never reaching counsel, screening-excluded applicants, and durable housing tails remain unjoined.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs household-level proof of counsel reach, representation depth, possession/displacement outcome, and durable stability including households that did not obtain counsel.
receipts.risk_if_missing: A statutory right or citywide percentage can hide unrepresented tenants and provider-capacity failures.
receipts.source_locator: NYC Comptroller right-to-counsel implementation report and GAO eviction-data limitations.

receipts.affected_person_gap: No receipt yet proves that a corrected screening record or assistance award led to a successful application, posted payment, protected possession, or re-housing.
receipts.claim: Tenant-screening and rental-assistance remedies must be followed through application, ledger, court, and housing-search tails.
receipts.closure_rule: Blocks repair claims until field/person outcome evidence is added; may justify tests and source boundaries only.
receipts.denominator_gap: Informal move-outs, illegal lockouts, households never reaching counsel, screening-excluded applicants, and durable housing tails remain unjoined.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs follow-through from assistance or screening correction to actual lease access, housing retention, and stability after remedy.
receipts.risk_if_missing: A corrected report or assistance award may be called repair while the household remains excluded or displaced.
receipts.source_locator: CFPB tenant-background-check page; NYC right-to-counsel implementation report; GAO eviction-data limitations.

receipts.affected_person_gap: No concrete household-level durable-stability evidence is stored or referenced by the cube.
receipts.claim: A housing-continuity packet cannot be closed as repaired until household tails show possession, displacement, shelter, re-housing, screening/application effect, and durable stability.
receipts.closure_rule: May support a housing closure protocol; cannot close the affected-person or claim-capture gap until household-tail outcome receipts exist.
receipts.denominator_gap: No household sample yet joins formal filings with informal exits, lockouts, counsel access failures, screening exclusions, shelter/re-housing, and stability follow-up.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs a privacy-approved household-tail sample from legal/rental assistance or filing to possession, displacement, shelter, re-housing, and stability.
receipts.risk_if_missing: The archive may label housing continuity repaired while households leave informally, lose possession, enter shelter, or remain screened out despite official remedy surfaces.
receipts.source_locator: GAO eviction-data limits; Eviction Lab filing-tracking surface; NYC Comptroller representation report; CFPB tenant-background-check guidance.

receipts.affected_person_gap: The sources report households served, representation rates, and aggregate remain/leave outcomes, but do not provide a privacy-bounded tail for households that never reached counsel, moved informally, were locked out, entered shelter, or lost stability after case closure.
receipts.claim: NYC right-to-counsel evidence provides aggregate household representation and housing-outcome signals, but it still does not close the household-tail gap for unrepresented, informal, or post-case stability outcomes.
receipts.closure_rule: Can justify housing-continuity tests and material-outcome questions, but cannot close the gap without household-tail validation.
receipts.denominator_gap: Unrepresented tenants, defaulted cases, informal move-outs, illegal lockouts, households outside eligibility, post-judgment displacement, and later instability remain outside the aggregate proof frame.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Privacy-bounded household follow-up that includes represented, unrepresented, default, informal-exit, illegal-lockout, shelter/re-housing, and stability-after-case tails.
receipts.risk_if_missing: The archive may treat a right to counsel or a representation percentage as proof of housing stability while the households outside the represented denominator disappear.
receipts.source_locator: NYC OCJ Annual Report 2025 main findings and tenant legal-services outcome figures; NYC Comptroller right-to-counsel representation/outcome sections; Eviction Lab right-to-counsel eligibility and implementation findings.

receipts.affected_person_gap: No held-claim sample connects status message, burden, cure, appeal/waiver, and payment after cure.
receipts.claim: A UI claim-status surface should expose actionable issue state and next steps, but status clarity is not payment proof.
receipts.closure_rule: Blocks repair claims until field/person outcome evidence is added; may justify tests and source boundaries only.
receipts.denominator_gap: Held, abandoned, falsely flagged, overpaid, waived, appealed, late-paid, and non-digital claimants are not joined to completed remedy outcomes.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs claimant-level follow-through from issue status and notice to cure attempt, eligibility/payment/debt state, and remedy completion.
minimum_next_receipts: payment or debt state after cure
receipts.risk_if_missing: A clear tracker can become claim-status theater if it does not prove that the valid claimant was paid or repaired.
receipts.source_locator: DOL claims-status implementation, notifications, and claimant-communication guidance on issue resolution, actionable next steps, and assisted/alternative channels.

receipts.affected_person_gap: Survey respondents and potential users are not the same as every valid claimant delayed, denied, abandoned, or paid late.
receipts.claim: UI claimant-experience surveys and user testing can identify pain points, but they do not alone validate all claimant outcomes or non-users.
receipts.closure_rule: Blocks repair claims until field/person outcome evidence is added; may justify tests and source boundaries only.
receipts.denominator_gap: Held, abandoned, falsely flagged, overpaid, waived, appealed, late-paid, and non-digital claimants are not joined to completed remedy outcomes.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs a sampled claimant tail from survey or user-test signal to actual claim submission, determination, payment, debt, waiver, or appeal result.
receipts.risk_if_missing: The archive may confuse experience research with proof that valid claimants received timely money.
receipts.source_locator: DOL ARPA UI modernization report claimant-experience section and Illinois survey/user-testing discussion; OMB A-11 Section 280 customer feedback baseline.

receipts.affected_person_gap: No receipt yet shows recovery paused, debt removed, waiver granted, identity theft corrected, or money released after cure for a concrete claimant.
receipts.claim: UI identity, overpayment, waiver, and recovery controls need claimant-level remedy receipts after false positive, agency error, identity theft, or waiver eligibility.
receipts.closure_rule: Blocks repair claims until field/person outcome evidence is added; may justify tests and source boundaries only.
receipts.denominator_gap: Held, abandoned, falsely flagged, overpaid, waived, appealed, late-paid, and non-digital claimants are not joined to completed remedy outcomes.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs claimant-level evidence that integrity controls produced lawful payment, debt removal, waiver relief, or appeal remedy rather than only agency recovery posture.
receipts.risk_if_missing: Payment blocks and recovery totals can be counted as integrity while valid claimants carry the error.
receipts.source_locator: DOL claims-status process guidance and ARPA modernization report as operational scaffolding for issue visibility and claimant support.

receipts.affected_person_gap: No concrete claimant-level post-cure outcome evidence is stored or referenced by the cube.
receipts.claim: A UI integrity/access packet cannot be closed as repaired until claimant-level outcomes show payment, debt, waiver, appeal, or identity-theft remedy after cure.
receipts.closure_rule: May support a UI closure protocol; cannot close the affected-person or claim-capture gap until claimant outcome receipts exist.
receipts.denominator_gap: No privacy-approved claimant sample yet joins issue state, notice, burden, cure path, appeal/waiver/identity state, and money/debt result after cure.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Needs a privacy-approved claimant outcome sample, not another official UI playbook or aggregate status surface.
receipts.risk_if_missing: The archive may label UI integrity/access repaired while valid claimants remain unpaid, indebted, or stuck after false positive or agency-error controls.
receipts.source_locator: DOL claims-status implementation and communication guidance; DOL ARPA modernization report; OMB A-11 customer-experience feedback floor.

receipts.affected_person_gap: The public pages show that some claimants were surveyed or observed; they do not join each participant to eligibility, payment, debt, waiver, appeal, or hardship outcome after the filing interaction.
receipts.claim: Direct observation and improved claimant surveys can expose UI filing burden and staff-intervention points, but they still do not prove that a claimant was paid or repaired.
receipts.closure_rule: Can raise the UI proof floor above official guidance, but remains a blocker until paired with a claimant outcome tail.
receipts.denominator_gap: Small or survey-exposed claimant groups do not represent all eligible people, non-users, abandonments, phone/in-person channel users, denied claimants, or people harmed after filing.
receipts.field_sample_requirement: Repeatable claimant sample that follows people from application burden through eligibility, payment, overpayment/debt, waiver/appeal, and hardship outcome without storing private identifiers in the cube.
minimum_next_receipts: sample frame including non-users and abandonments
receipts.risk_if_missing: The archive may treat claimant-centered research as completed benefit delivery rather than as a signal for where to inspect actual payment and remedy tails.
receipts.source_locator: DOL UI modernization claimant-observation page, research-goals/recruitment/conduct/outcome sections; DOL survey-design page, survey redesign and outcomes/takeaways sections; Digital Government Hub claimant-centric research section.
